name: Managed pressure drilling
principle: IADC defines MPD as an adaptive drilling process that precisely controls the annular pressure profile; a rotating control device and automated choke let the driller hold bottomhole pressure within a narrow window. Variants include continuous circulation, constant bottomhole pressure, pressurised mud cap and dual-gradient drilling.

process_steps.name: Seal annulus with a rotating control device

performance.metric: marine RCD tensile rating when placed below the riser tension ring

source.note: IADC, Managed pressure drilling (preview of the IADC publication)

advantages: Drills prospects considered undrillable with conventional methods
